docs.title: 📘 Code Mappings Documentation
docs.summary: Use code mappings to translate source-system values into canonical destination-system values for downstream processing.

fields.fromSystem: from_system: source system that produced the incoming code.
fields.toSystem: to_system: target system that receives the translated code.
fields.fromCode: from_code: source value from the origin system.
fields.toCode: to_code: mapped destination value consumed by AXIOM or external integrations.
fields.fromType: from_code_type: source code domain (for example currency, country, instrument).
fields.toType: to_code_type: destination code domain after translation.
fields.status: status: Active mappings participate in translation; Inactive mappings are retained for audit history.

docs.uniqueness: Uniqueness rule: from_system + to_system + from_code_type + to_code_type + from_code must be unique.
